_readme: Pipeboard Meta Ads + Google Ads MCP for Cursor.
RECOMMENDED (token auth — avoids localhost:8787 OAuth callback):
1. Open https://pipeboard.co/api-tokens and create/copy a Pipeboard API token.
2. Put the REAL token only in ~/.cursor/mcp.json (user-level Cursor MCP), not in project files:
3. Replace YOUR_PIPEBOARD_TOKEN with the real token (do not commit secrets).
4. Project .cursor/mcp.json should keep placeholders only; .cursor/mcp.json is gitignored.
5. Reload the Cursor window (Developer: Reload Window).
6. Confirm Meta Ads / Google Ads tools appear (servers should no longer show needsAuth).
2. Trigger mcp_auth and complete Facebook/Pipeboard approval quickly.
3. Keep Cursor focused; do not let the auth flow time out.
4. Safari must reach Cursor's callback on http://127.0.0.1:8787/callback.
If that page fails (Safari Can't Connect), the OAuth code is burned —
start a fresh OAuth attempt or switch to token auth.
Do not invent or paste example tokens. Never create ads or spend money from setup alone.

notes.why_token: Cursor OAuth uses a local callback on port 8787. If that listener is down, IPv4-only, or timed out, Safari fails after Facebook approval and the auth code is single-use/burned.
notes.after_token: Reload Cursor window, then verify GetMcpTools / MCP panel shows Meta Ads and Google Ads tools instead of needsAuth.
notes.security: Keep the real token in ~/.cursor/mcp.json only. Project .cursor/mcp.json uses placeholders and is listed in .gitignore.
